English: Accurate prediction and early recognition of type II diabetes (T2DM) will lead to timely and meaningful interventions, while preventing T2DM associated complications.
Luganda: Okuteebereza okutuufu n’okuzuula amangu ekika II eky’endwadde ya ssukaali (T2DM) kujja kuyambako okufuna mu budde, enkola ennungi eziyambako okujjanjaba, nga n’obuzibu obwekuusa ku T2DM buziyiziddwa.
Yoruba: Àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ tó gúnrégé àti ìtètè ṣedámọ̀ ìtọ̀ ṣúgà oríṣìí II (T2DM) yóò yọrí sí àtètè dásí tó nítumọ̀ nígbà tí a bá ń dènà àwọn ewu tó rọ̀mọ́ T2DM.
Zulu: Ukubikezela okunembile kanye nokuqashelwa kusenesikhathi kohlobo lwesifo sikashukela sohlobo lwesibili (T2DM) kuzoholela ekungeneleleni okufika ngesikhathi futhi okunengqondo, kube kuvimbela izinkinga ezihlobene ne-T2DM.
Hausa: Ingantacciyar tsinkaya da farkon ganewa na nau’in ciwon suga na II (T2DM) zai haifar da shiga cikin lokaci da kuma ma'ana, tare da hana rikice-rikice masu alaƙa da T2DM.
Northern Sotho: Go akanya ka fao go nepagetšego le go tseba ka pela ga mohuta wa II wa bolwetši bja swikiri (T2DM) go tla feletša ka ditsenogare tša ka pela le tše bohlokwa, mola ka go le lengwe go thibela tlhakatlhakano ya bolwetši ya go amana le T2DM.
Amharic: የ2ኛ ደረጃ ስኳር በሽታ (T2DM) ትክክለኛ ትንበያ እና ቅድመ እውቅና ከT2DM ጋር የተያያዙ ችግሮችን በመከላከል ወቅታዊ እና ትርጉም ወዳላቸው እርምጃዎች ያደርሳል።

English: In this context, machine learning (ML) is promising, as it can transform vast amount of T2DM data into clinically relevant information.
Luganda: Mu mbeera eno, enjigiriza kaabyuma (ML) ewa essuubi, kubanga esobola okukyusa obubaka bwa T2DM obuwererako ddala okusobola okufuna obubaka obw’omugaso mu bujjanjabi bw’endwadde.
Yoruba: Nínú inú àkóónú yìí, ìkẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ẹ̀rọ (ML) dára, ó lè ṣe àyípadà dáta T2DM lọ́pọ̀lọpọ̀ sí tí àlàyé ilé-ìwösàn tí ó nítumọ̀.
Zulu: Kulo mongo, ukufunda ngomshini (ML) kuyathembisa, njengoba kungaguqula inani elikhulu lengcobelelo ye-T2DM ibe ulwazi oluhlobene nomtholampilo.
Hausa: A wannan mahallin, koyan na’ura (ML) yana nuna nasara, saboda yana iya canza adadi mai yawa na bayanan T2DM zuwa bayanan da suka dace da asibiti.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo seemong se, go ithuta ka metšhene (ML) go a tshephiša, ka ge go ka kgona go fetoša tekano ye kgolo ya tshedimošo ya T2DM go ba tshedimošo ye e lego amleba go tša kalafo.
Amharic: በዚህ አውድ ውስጥ የማሽን አስተምሮ (ማ.አ) ተስፋ ሰጪ ነው ምክንያቱም የT2DMን መጠነ ሰፊ መረጃ ወደ ክሊኒካዊ ተዛምዶ ይቀይራል።

English: This study compares multiple ML techniques for predictive modelling based on different T2DM associated variables in an African population, Ghana.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kugeraageranya obukodyo bwa ML obw’enjawulo obukozesebwa okukola okuteebereza okusinziira ku byawuzi bya T2DM eby’enjawulo mu bantu abasangibwa mu Afirika mu ggwanga lya Ghana.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí ń ṣe àfiwé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ète ML fún sísọ àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ àwòṣe tí ó dá lórí oríṣìíríṣìí àwọn ajẹmọ́ T2DM nínú àwọn olùgbé ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà kan, orílẹ̀-èdè Ghana.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luqhathanisa amasu e-ML amaningi okumodela okubikezelwayo okusekelwe kwizicwaningwa ezahlukahlukene ezihlotshaniswa ne-T2DM kubantu base-Afrika, eGhana.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya kwatanta dabarun ML da yawa don ƙirar ƙididdiga bisa la’akari da abubuwa daban-daban masu alaƙa na T2DM a cikin yawan jama’ar Afirka, Ghana.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di bapetša mekgwa ye mentši ya ML ya go dira diphatišišo tša kakanyo tšeo di theilwego go mehuta ye e fapafapanego ya T2DM ka setšhabeng sa Afrika, ka Ghana.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በአፍሪካ በጋና ህዝብ ውስጥ የተለያዩ የተያያዙ የT2DM ተለዋዋጮች ላይ በመመስረት በርካታ የማ.አ ቴክኒኮችን ለትንበያ ሞዴል አሰራር ያነጻጽራል።

English: The study involves 219 T2DM patients and 219 healthy individuals who were recruited from the hospital and the local community, respectively.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kulimu abalwadde ba T2DM 219 abaafunibwa okuva mu ddwaliro n’abantu abalamu obulungi 219 abaafunibwa okuva mu kitundu.
Yoruba: Isẹ́ ìwádìí yìí níṣe pẹ̀lú àwọn aláìsàn 219 T2DM àti àwọn tí ara wọ́n dápé 219 tí a gbà láti ilé-ìwòsàn àti àwọn àgbègbè ìgbèríko, tẹ̀léra.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lubandakanya iziguli ezingama-219 ze-T2DM kanye nabantu abaphile kahle abangama-219 ababuthwe esibhedlela nasemphakathini wendawo, ngokulandelana.
Hausa: Hanyoyi Nazarin ya ƙunshi marasa lafiya guda 219 masu ɗauke da T2DM da kuma guda 219 masu lafiya waɗanda aka ɗauka daga asibiti da kuma al’ummar gari, bi-da-bi.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišišo di akareditše balwetši ba 219 ba T2DM le batho bao ba phetšego gabotse ba 219 bao ba ngwadišitšwego ka sepetlele le setšhabeng sa kgauswi.
Amharic: ዘዴዎች፡- ጥናቱ በቅደም ተከተል ከሆስፒታል እና ከአከባቢው ማህበረሰብ የተመለመሉ 219 T2DM በሽተኞችን እና 219 ጤነኛ ግለሰቦችን ያካተተ ነው።

English: Anthropometric and biochemical information including glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c), body mass index (BMI), blood pressure, fasting blood sugar (FBS), serum lipids [(total cholesterol (TC), triglycerides (TG), high and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-c and LDL-c)] were collected.
Luganda: Obubaka obukwata ku bipimo n’enkwajja z’omubiri omuli puloteyini ya ssukaali (HbA1c), obugabize bw’obuzito n’obuwanvu bw’omubiri (BMI), entunnunsi, ssukaali ali mu mubiri ng’omuntu asiibye (FBS), amasavu g’omu musaayi [[(amasavu g’omubiri gonna (TC), tulayigirisalayidi (TG), amasavu amangi n’amatono mu puloteyini etambuza amasavu mu mubiri (HDL-c and LDL-c)] bwafunibwa.
Yoruba: Àlàyé nípa Antopomẹ́tíríkì àti biokẹ́míkà pẹ̀lú gilaikátẹ́ẹ́dì Ìmogilobíìnì (HbA1c) àyẹwò ìwọ̀n ara (BMI) ìfúnpá, àyẹ̀wò ẹ̀jẹ̀ ṣáájú ìfúnpá gíga (FBS), àyẹ̀wò àrùn ọkàn, [[(iye kolẹ́sítírọ̀ (TC), tiragilisíráídì (TG) ìpọ̀jù àti ìkéré lipopopurotéénì kolẹ́sítírọ́ì (HDL-c àti LDL-c) náà ni a gbàjọ.
Zulu: Ulwazi lwe-anthropometric kanye ne-biochemical kufaka phakathi inhlolo shukela (HbA1c), inkomba yesisindo somzimba (BMI), umfutho wegazi, ushukela wegazi ozila ukudla (FBS), izinga lamafutha [[(amafutha aphelele (TC), amafutha agciniwe (TG), isisindo esiphansi nesiphezul samafutha i-lipoprotein (i-HDL-c ne-LDL-c)] yaqoqwa.
Hausa: An tattara bayanin Anthropometric da biochemical ciki har da haemoglobin glycated (HbA1c) da ma'aunin nauyin jiki (BMI) da hawan jini da sukarin jini mai azumi (FBS) da lipids na jini [(jimillar kiste (TC), triglycerides (TG), high and low-density lipoprotein] cholesterol (HDL-c da LDL-c)].
Northern Sotho: Tshedimošo ka ga kelo ya mmele wa motho le ya payokhemikhale go akaretšwa tlelaekheitetehaemotlelopini (HbA1c), dipalopalo ka ga boima bja mmele (BMI), kgatelelo ya madi a magolo, swikiri ya ka mading (FBS), dilipiti tša seramo [[(palomoka ya kholesterole (TC), theraetleseraete (TG), kholesterole ya liphophrotheine ya godimo le ya fase (HDL-c and LDL-c)] di ile tša kgobokletšwa.
Amharic: ከግሉኮስ ጋር የተደባለቀ ሂሞግሎቢንን (HbA1c) ጨምሮ ፣ የሰውነት ግዝፈት ጠቋሚ (ሰ.ግ.ጠ)፣ የደም ግፊት፣ በጾም የደም ስኳር (ጾ.ደ.ስ)፣ የእዥ ሊፒዶች [[(አጠቃላይ ኮሌስትሮል (አ.ኮ), ትራይ ግላይሰራይዶች (ት.ግ)፣ ከፍተኛ እና ዝቅተኛ-ጥግግት ያላቸው የኮሌስትሮል ሊፖፕሮቲኖች (HDL-c እና LDL-c)] የልኬታሰብ እና የህይወ ኬሚካል መረጃ ተሰብስቦ ነበር።

English: From this data, four ML classification algorithms including Naïve-Bayes (NB), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Decision Tree (DT) were used to predict T2DM.
Luganda: Mu bubaka buno, amateeka ga ML ana omuli Naïve-Bayes (NB), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Support Vector Machines (SVM) ne Decision Tree (DT) gaakozesebwa okuteebereza T2DM.
Yoruba: Nínú dátà yìí, ìsòrí ML oríṣìí mẹ́rin tí ó fi mọ́ Naive-Bayes (NB Naïve-Bayes (NB), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Decision Tree (DT) jẹ́ lílò láti ṣọ àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ T2DM.
Zulu: Kusukela kule ngcobelelo, ama-algorithms okuhlukanisa ama-ML amane afaka i-Nayiv-Bheyisi (NB), i-K-Makhelwane oseduze kakhulu (KNN), Imishini Yokusekela iVektha (SVM) kanye Nesihlahla Sesinqumo (DT) asetshenziswe ukubikezela i-T2DM.
Hausa: Daga waɗannan bayanan, an yi amfani da algorithms na rarrabuwar ML guda huɗu da suka haɗa da Naïve-Bayes (NB), K-Neaest Neighbor (KNN), Injinan Tallafin Vector (SVM) da Bishiyar Yanke Shawara (DT) domin tsinkayar T2DM.
Northern Sotho: Go tshedimošo ye, dialekorithimi tše nne tša tlhopo ya ML go akaretšwa Naïve-Bayes (NB), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Metšhene ya Bekthara ya Thušo (SVM) le Decision Tree (DT) di ile tša šomišwa go akanya T2DM.
Amharic: ከዚህ መረጃ የኔቭ-ቤይስ (ኔ.ቤ)፣የኬ-ተቀራራቢ ጎረቤት( ኬ.ተ.ጎ) የደጋፊ ቬከተር ማሽኖች(ደ.ቬ.ማ) እና የውሳኔ ዛፍ(ው.ዛ) መሳሪያዎችን ጨምሮ አራት የ ማ.አ ምድብ ስልተ ቀመሮች T2DMን ለመተንበይ ጥቅም ላይ ውለዋል።

English: Precision, Recall, F1-Scores, Receiver Operating Characteristics (ROC) scores and the confusion matrix were computed to determine the performance of the various algorithms while the importance of the feature attributes was determined by recursive feature elimination technique.
Luganda: Obutuukamu, Obujjukizi, emiwendo-F1, emiwendo gya Receiver Operating Characteristics (ROC) n’omweso ogwoleka enkola y’etteeka byabalibwa okusobola okuzuula enkola y’amateeka ag’enjawulo ate ng’omugaso gw’ebyawuzi gwafunibwa okuyita mu kakodyo ak’okuwandula ebyawuzi ebinafu.
Yoruba: Láìtàsé, Rántí, F1 Scores, ìwọ̀n Àtẹ Aṣàyẹ̀wò Ìṣedéédé (ROC) àti ààtò àyẹ̀wò jẹ́ fífi sórí láti mọ àbáyọri iṣẹ́ tí a ṣe nígbà tí pàtàkì àwọn àbùdá náà jẹ́ mímọ̀ nípasẹ̀ ète ìyọkúrò àbùdá àmúwọlé.
Zulu: Ukunembisisa, Ukubuyisa Inhlazane, Amaphuzu e-F1, Izimilo Ezisebenzayo Zomamukeli (ROC) nezibalo zokudideka zenziwe ikhompuyutha ukuze kutholwe ukusebenza kwama-algorithms ahlukahlukene ngenkathi ukubaluleka kwezibaluli zesici kunqunywa inqubo yokususa isici esiphindaphindayo.
Hausa: Daidaitawa da Tunawa da F1-Scores da Makin Ayyuka na mai Karɓa (ROC) da matrix ɗin rikicewa an ƙididdige su don ƙayyade aikin algorithms daban-daban yayin da mahimmancin sifofin fasalin an ƙaddara ta hanyar fasaha na kawar da fasalin maimaitawa.
Northern Sotho: Nepagalo, Go gopola, F1-Scores, dintlha tša Mekgwa ya Tirišo ya Seamogedi (ROC) le mathriksi wa kgakanego di ile tša tsenywa khomphutheng go tseba go šoma ga dialekorithimi tša mehutahuta mola e le gore bohlokwa bja dikokwane tša setlabelo di ile tša tsebja ka go diriša mokgwa wa go tloša setlabelo.
Amharic: የዋና መለያ ባህሪያት አይነታዎች አስፈላጊነት የሚወሰነው በተደጋጋሚ የዋና መለያ ባህሪያት ማስወገጃ ዘዴ ሆኖ ሳለ የትክክለኛነት፣ የትውስታ፣ የኤፍ 1-ውጤቶች እና የተቀባይ የአሰራር ባህሪያት(ተ.አ.ባ) ውጤቶች እና የግራ መጋባት ሜትሪክስ መፈተሻ መሳሪያዎች የተለያዩ ስልተ ቀመሮችን አፈጻጸም ለመወሰን ተሰልተዋል፡፡

English: All the classifiers performed beyond the acceptable threshold of 70% for the Precision, Recall, F-score and Accuracy.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa:Amateeka gonna gaakola bulungi ne gasukka omutindo ogukkirizibwa ogw’ebitundu 70% ku nsonga y’obutuukamu, obujjukizi, omuwendo-F n’obutuufu.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùpín iṣẹ́ yìí ṣiṣẹ́ kọjá àlà 70 àwọn ilé tí a tí làkalẹ̀, Rántí, F-Scores àti ìṣerẹ́gí.
Zulu: Zonke izihlukanisi zenziwe ngalé kwe-algorithms umkhawulo owamukelekayo ongama-70% woKunembisisa, Ukubuyisa inhlazane, F-score kanye Nokunemba.
Hausa: Dukkan ƙididdiga da aka yi fiye da yardajjen mafari na kashi 70% don Daidaitawa da Tunawa da F-Scores da kuma Daidaito.
Northern Sotho: Dipharologantši ka moka tšeo di dirilwego go feta mollwane wo o amogelegilego wa 70% wa Nepagalo, Go gopola, F-score le go Netefala.
Amharic: ሁሉም ተቀባይነት ካለው 70% በላይ የተከናወኑ ደረጃ መዳቢዎች ለትክክለኛነት፣ ለትውስት፣ለኤፍ-ውጤት እና ለእርግጠኛነት ነበሩ፡፡

English: After building the predictive model, 82% of diabetic test data was detected by the NB classifier, of which 93% were accurately predicted.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma lw’okuzimba omutetenkanyirizo oguteebereza, etteeka NB lyasobola okuzuula ebitundu 82% ery’obubaka obwoleka endwadde ya ssukaali ate nga mu byo, ebitundu 93% byateeberezebwa mu butuufu.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn tí a ti fi ìdí àsọtẹlẹ múlẹ̀, 82% àwọn dátà àyẹwò ìtọ̀-súgà ni a sàwárí láti ọwọ́ NB classifier tí a sì sọ àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ tí ṣe rẹ́gí 93%.
Zulu: Ngemuva kokwakha imodeli yokubikezela, ama-82% engcobelelo yokuhlolwa kwesifo sikashukela itholwe isiccisi i-NB, lapho ama-93% ayo ebikezelwe ngokunembile.
Hausa: Bayan ƙera samfurin tsinkayar, kashi 82% na bayanan gwajin ciwon suga an gano su ne ta hanyar NB classifier, wanda kashi 93% an yi hasashen daidai.

English: In this study, researchers successfully used a technique called machine learning to help them predict if a person has Type II Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM) or not.

English: T2DM, more commonly known as diabetes, is a disease where a patient has high levels of sugar in their blood, which can lead to severe complications like limb amputation or blindness.

Amharic: በተለምዶ የስኳር በሽታ በመባል የሚታወቀው T2DM ታማሚዎቹ ከፍተኛ የስኳር መጠን በደማቸው ውስጥ እንዲኖር የሚያደርግ በሽታ ሲሆን ይህም የእጅ ወይም የእግር መቆረጥን እና እውርነትን ሊያስከትሉ ወደሚችሉ ከባድ ውስብስቦች ሊዳርግ ይችላል።

English: Early diagnosis is key to treating the disease and preventing complications.
Luganda: Okumukebera amangu kya muwendo nnyo mu kujjanjaba endwadde eyo awamu n’okutangira obuzibu obuyinza okuvaamu.
Yoruba: Àyẹ̀wò ṣíṣe lójú ọjọ́ jẹ́ pàtàkì fún síṣètọ́jú àti dídènà àwọn àbájáde tí kò dára.
Zulu: Ukuxilongwa kusenesikhathi kuyisihluthulelo sokwelapha lesi sifo nokuvimbela izinkinga.
Hausa: Binciken farko shi ne mabuɗin don magance cutar da hana rikitarwa.
Northern Sotho: Go phekola e sa le ka pela go bohlokwa go alafa bolwetši bjo le go thibela go keka ga bolwetši.
Amharic: ቀድሞ በመመርመር በሽታውን ማወቅ ህመሙን ለማከም እና ውስብስብ ችግሮችን ለመከላከል ቁልፍ ነው።

English: In this study, the researchers tested if computers could help doctors predict if a person would have diabetes by looking at patient data linked with the disease.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baagezesa okulaba oba nga kompyuta zisobola okuyamba abasawo okuteebereza oba ng’omuntu yandifuna endwadde ya ssukaali nga batunuulira obubaka bw’abalwadde obwekuusa ku ndwadde eyo.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn olùṣèwádìí ti ṣe àyẹ̀wò láti wo bóyá ẹ̀rọ-kọ̀ǹpútà yóò lè ran àwọn oníṣègùn òyìnbọ́ lọ́wọ́ láti sọ àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ bóyá ènìyàn le ní àìsàn ìtọ̀-ṣúgà nípa wíwo dátà aláìsàn náà tó sopọ̀ mọ́ àìsàn náà.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo abacwaningi bahlole ukuthi amakhompyutha angabasiza yini odokotela ukubikezela ukuthi umuntu uzoba nesifo sikashukela ngokubheka imininingwane yesiguli ehambisana nalesi sifo.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun gwada ko kwamfutoci za su iya taimakawa likitoci su tantance ko mutum zai kamu da ciwon suga ta hanyar duba bayanan marasa lafiya da suke da alaƙa da cutar.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba ile ba dira diteko tša ge eba dikhomphutha di ka thuša dingaka go akanya ge eba motho a ka be a na le bolwetši bja swikiri ka go lebelela tshedimošo ya molwetši yeo e amantšhwago le bolwetši bjo.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎቹ ከበሽታው ጋር የተያያዙትን የታካሚውን መረጃዎች በመመልከት ግለሰቡ በስኳር በሽታ የመያዝ አዝማሚያውን ለመተንበይ ኮምፒውተሮች ዶክተሮችን ሊያግዟቸው ይችሉ እንደሆነ ፈትሸዋል።

English: They did their study in Ghana, with 219 people who had diabetes and 219 people who did not have diabetes.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwabwe baakukolera mu ggwanga lya Ghana, ku bantu 219 abaalina endwadde ya ssukaali n’abantu abalala 219 abataalina ndwadde ya ssukaali.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe iṣẹ́ ìwádìí wọn ní orílẹ̀-èdè Ghána, pẹ̀lú ènìyàn 219 tó ní àìṣàn ìtọ̀-ṣúgà àti ènìyàn 219 tí kò ní àìṣàn ìtọ̀-ṣúgà.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwabo balwenze eGhana, kunabantu abangama-219 abanesifo sikashukela kanti abangama-219 abangenaso isifo sikashukela.
Hausa: Sun yi nazarinsu ne a Ghana, tare da mutane guda 219 da suke da ciwon suga da kuma mutane guda 219 da ba su da ciwon suga.
Northern Sotho: Ba dirile dinyakišišo tša bona ka Ghana, fao go akareditšwego batho ba 219 bao ba bego ba na le bolwetši bja swikiri le ba 219 bao ba bego ba se na le bolwetši bja swikiri.
Amharic: ጥናታቸውን ያደረጉት በጋና ሲሆን የተካሄደውም 219 የስኳር በሽታ ባለባቸው እና 219 በሌለባቸው ሰዎች ላይ ነበር።

English: They noted the participants’ body mass, blood pressure, blood sugar levels and other potential indicators of diabetes.
Luganda: Baanokola obugabize bw’obuzito n’obuwanvu bw’emibiri gy’abeetabi, entunnunsi, obungi bwa ssukaali ali mu musaayi n’obubonero obulala obuyinza okwoleka endwadde ya ssukaali.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sàkìyésì ìwọ̀n ara àwọn olùkópa, ẹ̀jẹ̀ títẹ́, ìṣedéédé ṣúgà inú ara àti àwọn ohun pàtàkì mìíràn tó ń sàfihàn àìṣàn ìtọ̀-ṣúgà.
Zulu: Baphawule ubunzima bomzimba wabahlanganyeli, umfutho wegazi, amazinga kashukela egazini nezinye izinkomba ezingase zibe khona zesifo sikashukela.
Hausa: Sun lura da nauyin jikin mahalarta da hawan jinni da matakan suga na jini da sauran manunan alamun ciwon suga
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba ngwala boima bja mmele bja bakgathatema, kgatelelo ya madi a magolo, maemo a swikiri ya ka mading le dilaetši tše dingwe tše di kgonagalago tša bolwetši bja swikiri.
Amharic: የተሳታፊዎቹን የሰውነት ግዝፈት፣ የደም ግፊት፣ በደም ያለ የስኳር መጠን እና ሌሎች የስኳር በሽታ ጠቋሚዎች የመሆን አቅም ያላቸውን ነገሮች አይተዋል።

English: Their aim was to see if their computer program could use these indicators to accurately differentiate between the patients who had diabetes and those who did not.
Luganda: Ekigendererwa kyabwe kyali kya kulaba oba pulogulaamu yaabwe ey’oku kompyuta esobola okukozesa obubonero buno okwawula wakati w’abalwadde abaalina endwadde ya ssukaali n’abo abataagirina.
Yoruba: Èrò wọn ni láti mọ̀ bóyá a lè lo ẹ̀rọ kọ̀ǹpúta wọn láti ṣe àfihàn àwọn àpẹẹrẹ yìí láti ṣe ìyàtọ̀ láàrin àwọn aláìsàn tí ó ní ìtọ̀ ṣúgà àti àwọn tí kò ní lọ́nà tó gún régé.
Zulu: Inhloso yabo bekuwukubona ukuthi uhlelo lwabo lwekhompyutha lungakwazi yini ukusebenzisa lezi zinkomba ukuhlukanisa kahle iziguli ezinesifo sikashukela nalezo ezingenaso.
Hausa: Manufarsu ita ce su ga ko shirin nasu na kwamfuta zai iya amfani da waɗannan alamomi domin bambancewa daidai a tsakanin majinyata masu ciwon suga da waɗanda ba su da shi.
Northern Sotho: Maikemišetšo e be e le go bona ge eba lenaneo la bona la khomphutha le ka šomiša dilaetši tše go farologanya ka maleba magareng ga balwetši bao ba nago le bolwetši bja swikiri le bao ba bego ba se na le bjona.
Amharic: አላማቸው የኮምፒውተር ፕሮግራም እነዚህን ጠቋሚዎች በመጠቀም ስኳር በሽታ ያለባቸው ታካሚዎችን ከሌለባቸው በትክክል መለየት ይችል እንደሆነ ማየት ነበር።

English: The computer correctly predicted the diabetes status for up to 87% of the participants.
Luganda: Kompyuta yateebereza mu butuufu embeera y’endwadde ya ssukaali okutuukira ddala ku bitundu 87% eby’abeetabi.
Yoruba: Ẹ̀rọ kọ̀ǹpúta náà sọ àṣọtẹ́lẹ̀ tó gún régé fún ipò tí àìsàn ìtọ̀-ṣúgà wà ní ara ìdá 87% àwọn olùkópa.
Zulu: Ikhompyutha isibikezele kahle isimo sesifo sikashukela kubantu abangafika kuma-87% abahlanganyeli.
Hausa: Kwamfuta ta yi hasashen yanayin ciwon suga daidai da kashi 87% na mahalarta.
Northern Sotho: Khomphutha e ile ya kgona go akanya maemo a bolwetši bja swikiri go fihla ka 87% ya bakgathatema.
Amharic: ኮምፒውተሩ እስከ 87% ለሚሆኑ ተሳታፊዎች የስኳር በሽታ ደረጃን በትክክል ተንብዯል።

English: Even the computer formula with the lowest accuracy was correct for 74% of participants, which they said was still good.
Luganda: Olaba n’etteeka lya kompyuta eryalina obutuufu obwa wansi ddala lyakola okuteebereza okutuufu ku beetabi abakola ebitundu 74%, ne bagamba nti ekyo kyali kikyali kirungi.
Yoruba: Kódà ọ̀nà tí ẹ̀rọ kọ̀ǹpúta náà gbà ṣe tirẹ̀ tí ó ní ìṣedéédé tó kéré jùlọ fún 74% àwọn olùkópa, tí wọ́n sọ pé ó sì dára.
Zulu: Ngisho nefomula yekhompyutha enembayo ephansi yayilungile kuma-74% wabahlanganyeli, abathi iseyinhle.
Hausa: Koda tsarin kwamfuta tare da mafi ƙarancin daidaito daidai ne ga 74% na mahalarta, wanda suka ce har yanzu yana da kyau.
Northern Sotho: Le fomula ya khomphutha yeo e bego e na le nepagalo ya fase e be e nepagetše go bakgathatema ba 74%, yeo ba boletšego gore e be e sa le kaone.
Amharic: ትክክለኛነቱ እጅግ ዝቅተኛ የሆነው የኮምፒውተር ፕሮግራም እንኳ 74% ለሚሆኑ ተሳታፊዎች ትንበያው ትክክል የነበረ ሲሆን ይህም እራሱ ጥሩ ነው ብለዋል።

English: The researchers said that even though older people are more at risk for diabetes, their study could not predict whether someone was more likely to have diabetes just by looking at their age.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti newankubadde ng’abantu bakuliridde mu myaka balina akatyabaga ka waggulu okufuna endwadde ya ssukaali, okunoonyereza kwabwe tekwasobola kuteebereza oba ng’omuntu yalina emikisa mingi egifuna endwadde ya ssukaali nga batunuulidde butunuulizi myaka gye.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùkópa sọ pé bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àwọn àgbàlagba sísílẹ̀ sí ewu ìtọ̀ ṣúgà síi, iṣẹ́ ìwádìí wọn kò sọ bóyá ó ṣeéṣe kí ẹnìkan ó ní àìsàn ìtọ̀-ṣúgà nípa wíwo ọjọ́ orí wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe nakuba abantu abadala besengozini enkulu yokuba nesifo sikashukela, ucwaningo lwabo alukwazanga ukubikezela ukuthi kungenzeka yini ukuthi umuntu abe nesifo sikashukela ngokubheka iminyaka yakhe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce duk da cewa tsofaffi sun fi fuskantar haɗarin kamuwa da ciwon suga, binciken nasu ba zai iya tantance ko wani zai iya kamuwa da ciwon suga kawai ta hanyar duba shekarunsa ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore le ge e le gore batho ba bagolo ba kotsing ye kgolo ya go ba le bolwetši bja swikiri, dinyakišišo tša bona ga se tša akanya ge eba motho yo mongwe go be go na le kgonagalo ya gore a ka ba le bolwetši bja swikiri ka go no lebelela mengwaga ya gagwe.
Amharic: ምንም እንኳ በእድሜ የገፉ ሰዎች በስኳር በሽታ የመያዛቸው አደጋ ከፍተኛ ቢሆንም የአንድን ሰው እድሜ ብቻ በመመልከት በስኳር በሽታ የመያዙ አጋጣሚ ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ ወይም እንዳልሆን ጥናታቸው መተንበይ እንደማይችል ተመራማሪዎቹ ተናግረዋል።

English: They said this could be because older patients may show signs of diabetes even without having diabetes.
Luganda: Baagamba nti kino kiri kityo kubanga abalwadde abakuliridde mu myaka basobola okwoleka obubonero bw’endwadde ya ssukaali ne bwe baba nga tebagirina.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé àwọn àgbàlagbà le máa fi àwọn àpẹẹrẹ àìsàn ìtọ̀-ṣúgà hàn láìṣepé wọ́n ní àìsàn ìtọ̀-ṣúgà.
Zulu: Bathe lokhu kungenxa yokuthi iziguli esezikhulile zingakhombisa izimpawu zesifo sikashukela noma zingenawo.
Hausa: Sun ce hakan yana iya zama saboda tsofaffin marasa lafiya suna iya nuna alamun ciwon suga ko da ba tare da ciwon suga ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore se se ka ba ka lebaka la gore balwetši ba bagolo ba ka bontšha maswao a bolwetši bja swikiri le ge e le gore ga ba na le bolwetši bja swikiri.
Amharic: ይህ ሊሆን የቻለው ደግሞ በእድሜ የገፉ ታካሚዎች ስኳር በሽታ ባይኖራቸውም እንኳ የስኳር በሽታ ምልክቶች ሊታዩባቸው ስለሚችሉ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል።

English: The researchers said their study have proved that computers could indeed help detect whether someone has diabetes or not, and this could help poorer countries such as Ghana to test for diabetes cheaply yet accurately.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti okunoonyereza kwabwe kukakasizza nti kompyuta zisobolera ddala okuyambako mu kuzuula oba ng’omuntu alina endwadde ya ssukaali oba nedda, era nga kino kyandiyamba amawanga amankuseere gamba nga Ghana okukebeza endwadde ya ssukaali ku bbeeyi eya layisi naye ate mu butuufu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé iṣẹ́ ìwádìí wọn ti fihàn pé ẹ̀rọ kọ̀ǹpúta le wúlò láti mọ̀ bóyá ẹnìkan ní àìsàn ìtọ̀-ṣúgà tàbí kò ní, àti wí pé eléyìí yóò ran àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí kò lówó-lọ́wọ́ bíi orílẹ̀-èdè Ghana láti ṣe àyẹ̀wo àìsàn ìtọ̀-ṣúgà pẹ̀lú owó kékeré tí àyèwò náà yóò si ṣe rẹ́gí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe ucwaningo lwabo lufakazele ukuthi amakhompyutha angasiza ngempela ukuthola ukuthi umuntu unesifo sikashukela noma cha, futhi lokhu kungasiza amazwe ampofu njengeGhana ukuthi ahlolele isifo sikashukela ngenani eliphansi kodwa ngendlela enembile.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce binciken da suka yi ya tabbatar da cewa kwamfutoci suna iya taimakawa wajen gano ko wani yana da ciwon suga ko a’a, kuma hakan yana iya taimakawa ƙasashe masu fama da talauci kamar Ghana wajen yin gwajin cutar suga mai rahusa, kuma daidai.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dinyakišišo tša bona di file bohlatse bja gore ka nnete dikhomphutha di ka thuša go utolla ge eba motho o na le bolwetši bja swikiri goba aowa, gomme se se ka thuša dinaga tše di hlokago tša go swana le Ghana go dira diteko tša bolwetši bja swikiri ka tšhelete ya fase le ka fao go nepagetšego.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ኮምፒውተሮች በእርግጥም አንድ ሰው የስኳር በሽታ እንዳለበት ወይም እንደሌለበት ለማወቅ ሊረዱ እንደሚችሉ እና ይህም እንደ ጋና ያሉ ደሃ ሃገሮች የስኳር በሽታን በርካሹ ግን በትክክሉ መመርመር ይችሉ ዘንድ ሊያግዙ እንደሚችሉ ጥናታቸው ማረጋገጡን ተናግረዋል።

English: They however cautioned that they used a small number of participants for their study, and this might have affected their results.
Luganda: Wabula baalabula nti baakozesa abeetabi batono mu kunoonyereza kwabwe, era nga kino kiyinza okuba nga kyakosa bye baazuula.
Yoruba: Wọ́n kìlọ̀ pé olùkópa kékeré ni àwọn lò fún iṣẹ́ ìwádìí wọn, eléyìí sì ti lè ṣe àkóbá fún àbájáde àwọn èsi wọn.
Zulu: Nokho baxwayise ngokuthi basebenzise isibalo esincane sabahlanganyeli ocwaningweni lwabo, futhi lokhu kungenzeka kube nomthelela emiphumeleni yabo.
Hausa: Duk da haka sun yi gargaɗin cewa sun yi amfani da mahalarta kaɗan domin nazarinsu, kuma hakan yana iya shafar sakamakonsu.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale ba ile ba lemoša gore ba šomišiotše palo ya afse ya bakgatahtema ka dinyakišišong tša bona, gomme se se ka be se ile sa ama dipoelo tša bona.
